basic_profile.bio: Avid tech enthusiast and crypto miner based in Dublin, Ireland. I work as a software developer specializing in blockchain technologies. I'm passionate about decentralized finance and spend my free time researching new developments in the crypto space. Outside of work, I enjoy gaming, particularly RPGs and indie games, and I'm a regular at the local gym. I'm married with two kids, which keeps me on my toes. I'm typically online in the evenings and late at night, balancing family life with my digital pursuits.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science and have spent over a decade working in software development, with the last five years focused on blockchain solutions. My interest in crypto mining began as a hobby, but it has since become a significant part of my professional and personal life. I've self-taught myself through online courses, forums, and hands-on experience.
